decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core business and given its own product page, it reflects meaningful investment and public commitment, so management is likely to continue it and treat any early market frictions as temporary.

A modular camera line with several models signals especially high development effort and strategic relevance for future flexible spacecraft systems, which makes escalation of commitment strongest here.

This sensor suite builds on existing capabilities and was publicly presented as a stand-alone offer, so in a growing R&D-intensive space-electronics context the firm is likely to persist rather than admit a premature mistake.

Although its website presence was weaker than the others, the miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR still fits the firm's announced move toward compact advanced sensors, so management would more likely keep it than withdraw it after only a short time.
